verdict.rationale: The release notes show OCI ships first-party AI features that sit next to customer data: Select AI, with a Java SDK, and a Select AI Agent Framework whose agent teams are defined and run inside database schemas. However, the evidence never says these features produce insights or suggestions from the user's data in the product UI. OCI Generative AI model import is only a developer building block and earns no credit. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI-generated insights or recommendations over user data, an in-console experience, a description of what Select AI does with data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
